video_title: Miami Heat are STREAKING! Are They TRUE Contenders in the East?!

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on the Miami Heat's potential as Eastern Conference contenders
quotes.excerpt: I think the real game changers and X-factors in this situation are Bam Adebayo and Klay Thompson.
quotes.quote: They are playing better basketball and that is all that really matters now. It is a lot of season left. When this team is constructed, yes, that was the expectation and I am sure that was the goal from everybody that agreed in that situation. But they had a very rough start and that happens. They are off to now a six-game winning streak. They are playing some really good basketball. Obviously, Giannis is doing what he does, but I think the real game changers and X-factors in this situation are Bam Adebayo and Klay Thompson. They have been the most consistent, as far as even when they were playing through the slump, they were playing at a really high level.
quotes.social_post: DeMarcus Cousins says the Miami Heat are finally playing to their potential during this win streak, calling Bam Adebayo and Klay Thompson the real X factors for this team.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons and DeMarcus Cousins on Davion Mitchell's elite two-way play
quotes.excerpt: The dude is leading the NBA in assists, bro. He is a two-way player, for sure.

text_blocks.speaker: Chandler Parsons
text_blocks.text: It is crazy because you said defensive pest, which Davion Mitchell was, but I feel like at this point, it is almost a disservice calling him that. The dude is leading the NBA in assists, bro. He is a two-way player, for sure. I will be honest with you, I did not know. I was not aware. I thought he was no shade to Pat Bev, I thought he was a Pat Bev, pick you up, junkyard dog. I did not know he was a 17 and nine and a half lead with the assists.

text_blocks.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
text_blocks.text: He was a bucket in college. He was a two-way player, for sure.

quotes.social_post: Chandler Parsons admits he underestimated Davion Mitchell, saying it is a disservice to call him just a defensive pest when he is leading the NBA in assists and playing like a true two way player.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on Davion Mitchell's role and Bam Adebayo's impact
quotes.excerpt: Bam finally woke up. He is the guy that they paired up with Giannis to make this thing go.
quotes.quote: When they got off to a slow start, when we were saying what adjustments should be made, we were kind of making him the scapegoat and I am like, no, he is doing his job. Sure, we want a setup point guard, he is setting them up. He is doing his part. I look at Spo, the adjustments he made, bringing Wiggins off the bench, giving them more of a balance. Now you got Wiggins, you got Porter, you got our guy Bobby coming off the bench. Now you got a balance. But the biggest caveat of all of this to me has been Bam. Bam finally woke up. He is the guy that they paired up with Giannis to make this thing go. He has become more consistent in how he is playing, he has become aggressive, and he has become the number one option guy that he has been in Miami for this group.
quotes.social_post: Lou Williams credits Erik Spoelstra for his rotation adjustments and says Bam Adebayo has finally woken up to become the consistent number one option the Heat need.

quotes.speaker: Chandler Parsons
quotes.summary_phrase: Chandler Parsons on Klay Thompson's impressive return to form
quotes.excerpt: To see him playing the way he is playing now really stokes me.
quotes.quote: I spent some time with Klay this summer and he did not seem that positive. He did not seem that stoked. To see him playing the way he is playing now really stokes me and obviously, he is huge for the success of the Heat style-wise and fitting with Giannis, spacing the floor, shooting the way that we know he can shoot it. But that just honestly makes me happy that he is overcome all these injuries and he is in a good place mentally. He is happy, he is winning, he is on a winning basketball team. Klay Thompson is back and I love that.
quotes.social_post: Chandler Parsons says he is happy to see Klay Thompson back to form after spending time with him this summer, noting that Klay is in a much better place mentally now that he is winning.

quotes.speaker: DeMarcus Cousins
quotes.summary_phrase: DeMarcus Cousins on Giannis Antetokounmpo's status as a top-five player
quotes.excerpt: As long as he is healthy and he is playing 30 plus minutes, he is going to be a top five player.
quotes.quote: As long as he is healthy and he is playing 30 plus minutes, he is going to be a top five player in the NBA. That is just what he does. If he is getting the minutes and if he is on the floor, he is going to dominate no matter who he is playing, who is guarding him, what defense it is, what team it is. Giannis is a top five when he is healthy and available, simple as that.
quotes.social_post: DeMarcus Cousins keeps it simple regarding Giannis Antetokounmpo, stating that as long as he is healthy and getting his minutes, he is a top five player in the NBA regardless of the matchup.

quotes.speaker: Michelle Beadle
quotes.summary_phrase: Michelle Beadle on the Milwaukee Bucks' struggles and roster
quotes.excerpt: They have lost 11 in a row, that is so demoralizing.
quotes.quote: One and 14. They have lost 11 in a row, that is so demoralizing. And their starting lineup last night was Hero, Kuzma, Miles Turner, Jericho Sims, and Burry. I do not know if you want to say worst team in the league, maybe that is a little too hurtful, but is this the worst team in the league?
quotes.social_post: Michelle Beadle questions if the Milwaukee Bucks are the worst team in the league after a demoralizing 11 game losing streak.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the Milwaukee Bucks' growing pains and Sacramento's struggles
quotes.excerpt: I hate to throw this shot, but Sacramento has been consistently bad.
quotes.quote: They are going through some real growing pains. I thought that Hero, Kuzma, and Turner connect, I thought that was going to be a good matchup for them. I liked AJ Green what he was able to do in the past. It just has not lined up. I am not going to say they are the worst team in the league, I hate to throw this shot, but Sacramento has been consistently bad and they are right there in the boat with Milwaukee, being at the bottom of the barrel. But both of those teams have enough talent to not be in the positions they are in. You got to give respect where it is due.
quotes.social_post: Lou Williams says the Bucks and Kings are both at the bottom of the barrel right now, despite both teams having enough talent to be performing much better than they currently are.

quotes.speaker: Lou Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Lou Williams on the value of coaching experience and taking difficult jobs
quotes.excerpt: I think that is part of the gig to see what can I bring to the table.
quotes.quote: Absolutely. I think that is part of the gig to see what can I bring to the table. How good am I at my job? And I will say, he has got to have a longer runway taking that knowing what it is. It is not like they are going to go 10 and 72 this year and then fire Taylor Jenkins. That cannot be real.
quotes.social_post: Lou Williams argues that coaches like Taylor Jenkins deserve a longer runway to prove themselves, noting that you cannot expect a total turnaround in one season.
